tables.name: __CROSS_CUTTING_DB_LAYER_FIX__
issues: db/connection.ts query()/get()/run() previously passed bound params straight through to node:sqlite's DatabaseSync, which throws ("Provided value cannot be bound to SQLite parameter N") on any undefined param — unlike most sqlite drivers. Because nearly every PATCH/partial-update handler destructures optional fields straight from req.body into a COALESCE(?, col)-style query, ANY partial update omitting a field crashed with HTTP 500. Verified live failures before the fix: PATCH /api/cases/:id with only {priority}, PATCH /api/admin/configs/:key with no description. FIXED by sanitizing undefined -> null once in connection.ts, verified both calls now succeed.
